202.description: Persisted task or existing idempotent receipt

get.description: Durable SSE. Event names gateway/task/resync. ID is the database cursor. Resync data is an empty object; gateway/task data uses Event. Session and tenant authorization is rechecked each second.

200.description: SSE stream with ID and event type

get.summary: Read a persisted task by ID within the authenticated tenant

404.description: Task absent or outside the tenant

CreateTask.description: network.prepare requires networkChange; network.confirm/rollback/transaction require networkAction. Other operations reject these fields. Writes require admin. Task success reports execution of the request; inspect result.state for the independent network transaction outcome. Takeover plan/prepare require networkTakeover; takeover.prepare is admin-only. kura.configuration.get requires kuraConfiguration with pid and en/zh locale; all other operations reject that target. It is a read operation available to operator/admin. kura.configuration.update requires admin and kuraConfigurationUpdate, a current revision and typed set-only properties. Gateway capability must be enabled. Omitted fields and passwords stay unchanged. Unknown writes are never automatically replayed.

NetworkTakeover.description: plan accepts only interface. prepare requires the reviewed expectedRevision/sourceDigest/planDigest and confirmation window 30–300 seconds.

pid.description: Nonblank PID, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.

editable.description: Declared field has a supported set representation without constraints requiring further validation.

KuraConfigurationProperty.description: Numeric values are decimal strings to preserve Java long precision. A redacted property has no value. Defaults and options are never exported. This projection cannot identify arbitrary secrets embedded in user scripts.

updateEnabled.description: Explicit audited PID policy is enabled on the Kura bridge; independent agent and admin permission also required.

KuraConfigurationView.description: Successful operation 11 task result; bounded to 200 KiB by the local bridge. Online read through the OSGi ConfigurationService, independent of Kura Web credentials.
